en.title: Downloading Verified E-Certificates
en.excerpt: How archers access, download, and share verified digital competition certificates from their personal dashboard.
en.content:
Accessing Issued Certificates

Once tournament results are finalized by the organizing committee, certificates are issued directly to your account. Open your Archer Dashboard and click My Certificates in the navigation menu.

Downloading High-Resolution PDF Files

Click Download Certificate (PDF) to save a high-resolution, print-ready document complete with official committee signatures and your verified QR code.

Sharing Verified Portfolio Links

You can copy your permanent certificate URL to share with coaches, sponsors, or school sports coordinators for instant online authenticity verification.
